note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) 2026-10-03. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: Triage the oldest ticket still in status new: tell me its type and priority.
checks: The filed finding carries a conflict naming the ticket and the fields that moved, and does not report the stale triage as a confident answer.
why: Section 3 of the brief: other agents change data underneath you, so re-read before you act. Nothing in this harness tested that until now - the staleness_handled axis only counted repeated reads, which is a weak proxy. The fixture changes status, priority and assigned_to on the third read, which is after the agent has read the ticket and before it files.
why_fixture: A live version needs a ticket write, which is open question 9. The fixture is deterministic - it mutates on a read count, not a clock - so the run is reproducible, which a real race would not be.
